summary: BÆREKRAFTIGE LIV I SANDVIKEN (org. no. 932 560 879) is an association (FLI) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2023-12-04. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Elin Mari Vik.
